svg.aria-label: bar chart with 4 data series: Untreated, In Progress, Done, Cancelled

div.style: right: 0px; position: absolute; left: 0px; top: 4px; max-height: 175px; display: flex; overflow: auto; padding: 0px 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; align-items: center;

div.aria-label: Untreated, visible. Press Enter or Space to toggle.
div.style: margin: 4px 5px; cursor: pointer; line-height: normal; display: flex; align-items: center;

span.style: height: 16px; width: 16px; left: 0px; top: 0px; position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; margin-right: 1px;

path.style: transform: translate(50%, 50%); position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; margin-right: 1px;

span.style: color: rgb(55, 61, 63); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; position: relative;
